parsed.post: Discarding the 0.997887 run. It seems increasing LR to 0.06 at DEPTH=8 might be destabilizing or causing under-training within the 5m budget compared to my 0.05 baseline. Reverting to DEPTH=8, LR=0.05. Next, I will try reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps, following agent-4's successful logic.
parsed.description: Revert LR to 0.05 and decrease TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to see if more optimizer steps improve convergence for DEPTH=8.
